purpose: Security posture for OZM prose, scripts, assets, stdout, and credential boundaries.

proseTrust.activeSkillMarkdown: operator-maintained; must pass route/eval/guard and avoid payload-less compliance hijacking
proseTrust.donorReferences: background evidence only unless absorbed into OZM owner contracts

scriptTrust.normalSkillScripts: must appear in package-manifest.json with sha256, allowed effects, network posture, stdout data class, and secret scan posture
scriptTrust.assetScripts: must appear in asset-runtime-manifest.json and remain disabled_by_default

networkPosture.networkCapableScripts: disabled_by_default and require explicit authorization_env or asset-runtime approval

covers: global config mutation without permission context
proseSecurityScan.claimEffect: A public or release package with prose-security findings stays security_candidate until findings are removed, quoted as negative fixtures, or explicitly moved to archive/historical context.
